caption:
Models usually return what you ask for. Usually isn't good enough for code that runs in production.

A missing field or a number where you expected a string will crash your UI somewhere far away from the actual cause.

This uses Zod, a validation library. Out.parse throws a clear error the moment the shape is wrong, so you can retry the request or show a fallback.

Many AI APIs now also support structured outputs (you pass a JSON schema). Still validate. It's one line.

Source: zod.dev.
